title: Exact van der Waerden numbers
exact_target: Let $W(r,k)$ be the least $N$ such that every coloring of $\{1,\ldots,N\}$ with $r$ colors contains a monochromatic arithmetic progression of length $k$. Determine the unknown exact values of $W(r,k)$.
